settings.coloredBar.on: Status bar colors green and red.
settings.coloredBar.off: Same color as the other bar icons.
settings.pauseOnLock.on: Timer pauses while locked or suspended, then continues.
settings.pauseOnLock.off: Timer keeps running while locked or suspended.
